claim_boundary: External trajectory records are real pinned LongMemEval-V2 sample excerpts. Two structural state anchors are taken per selected trajectory. Lifecycle standing changes are controlled synthetic post-finalization injections. The 40 episodes are not 40 independent trajectories. This is not the DGRR private 50-case adaptation or the full LongMemEval-V2 benchmark.

decision_family.D1: coarse environment decision remains supported by E2 while its E1-only state_url export loses support
decision_family.D2: depends specifically on D1.state_url and must reopen
decision_family.D3: depends on D1.core_environment and must survive
decision_family.D4: independent E2.domain branch and must survive

source_selection.eligibility: non-empty id/domain/environment; at least two states; at least two states with non-empty url
source_selection.selected_states: first and last usable state by source-list order

strong_baselines.DGRR_CONTRACT_NODE_SUPPORT_EXTERNAL_V1: diagnosed-root descendant tracing with conservative independent support only from outside the affected set
strong_baselines.MEMOREPAIR_CONTRACT_PROPERTY_VALIDATION_: barrier-first withdrawal of the full affected set plus exact property-aware successor validation; intentionally favorable to MemoRepair
